mapper.sql: select r.region_id, r.parent_id, r.ancestors, r.region_name, r.region_level, r.order_num, r.status, r.del_flag, r.description, r.remark, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time from trace_region r
mapper.select: select r.region_id, r.parent_id, r.ancestors, r.region_name, r.region_level, r.order_num, r.status, r.del_flag, r.description, r.remark, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, (select region_name from trace_region where region_id = r.parent_id) as parent_name from trace_region r where r.region_id = #{regionId} and r.del_flag = '0'
